title: Theaters (The Whole Film at Once)
summary: A generated film integrates in real time into a single glowing blank screen — the more you are shown, the less there is to see.
mechanism: Canvas running-mean accumulation: each film frame is composited at globalAlpha 1/n (the incremental average) via requestAnimationFrame, converging to a uniform field while getImageData reports the collapsing variance σ.
